transformations: transcribed from Census BTOS, Challenger reports, company reports, press summaries and the NY Fed; see docs/data-inventory.md
notes: Observed series the model is scored against for 2024Q1-2026Q2 (review §2.2). model_metric names the model quantity: adoption_share_firm_weighted (BTOS share of firms using AI), ai_layoffs_cum (announced AI-cited job cuts since 2023; the model's laid_off_cum plus the 2023 count that precedes the horizon), ai_producer_revenue_bn (world), hyperscaler_capex_bn (the capex path, an input), none (context only: the model does not track the quantity). used_in_fit marks rows that were used to set a parameter.
